Train A: leaves city A at 9:00, speed = 80 km/h
Train B: leaves city B at 9:30, speed = 100 km/h
Distance between A and B = 300 km

Let me set up the problem:
- Let t be the time in hours after 9:00 when they meet.
- Train A travels for t hours, covering distance 80t km from city A.
- Train B leaves at 9:30, so it travels for (t - 0.5) hours, covering 100(t - 0.5) km from city B.

When they meet, the sum of distances from their respective cities equals 300 km:
80t + 100(t - 0.5) = 300
80t + 100t - 50 = 300
180t = 350
t = 350/180 = 35/18 ≈ 1.944 hours = 1 hour and 56.67 minutes

So they meet at approximately 10:56:40 (9:00 + 1h 56m 40s).

Distance from city A = 80 × 35/18 = 2800/18 = 1400/9 ≈ 155.56 km
